text:
Marta R: Heads-up: planning the AUTO fallback UX for the rollout next week. Need quick consensus on two things: safety budgets (to cap cost/impact) and audit/sampling behavior for dry-run. I sketched a couple of ideas, posting for reactions.

Kai Chen: :eyes: Agree we need a clear safety_budget. Without it fallbacks can unintentionally shift cost/latency. Suggest exposing both percent-of-route and an absolute floor.

Jon P: Question — percent-of-route or absolute tokens? Percent scales but ops teams will want hard limits.

Samir A: Leaning pct + floor. Example config snippet:```json
{"safety_budget": {"mode": "percent", "value": 0.05, "min_tokens": 1000}}
``` That way small customers still get a safety floor.

Lee S: Audit side: dry-run should STILL emit the same decision traces and full payload captures (redacted), but be labeled as "simulated" so it doesn't affect billing or metrics. We also need per-route sampling controls.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled canary: 2024-05-05T18:30:00Z (rfd-20240505-7) — will rollout auto-fallback feature to 5% traffic in staging/org-sandbox first.

Kai Chen: Also want explicit trigger_conditions, e.g. 500-rate > 1% over 1m, latency.p95 > 2s, queue_depth > 80%. Fallback should only execute if triggers AND safety_budget allow it.

Marta R: UX needs: live "budget burn" gauge in console, recent fallback events with reason + affected route, and a lightweight "playback" button to replay sampled requests in audit mode (safe sandbox). Also a retention/PRIVACY note for stored request snapshots.

Samir A: Playback requires secure sandbox + ephemeral creds + rotation. Also propose: error traces => 100% sampling for 24h after spike; normal routes => 0.1% sampling by default.

Jon P: Implementation question: can we standardize trace fields as `fallback.reason`, `fallback.variant`, and `decision_trace_id` so queries/alerts are simple?

Lee S: Yes — also persist a small `cache_snapshot_id` for cases where KV/prefix cache influenced the decision, so playback can restore context.

Marta R: Cool. Can someone draft a minimal policy schema (JSON) that includes: safety_budget, trigger_conditions, sample_rates, and playback retention? I'll convert to console mockups after.

Kai Chen: I'll put a draft in the RFC doc today and link it.

Samir A: I'll add the telemetry sampling heuristics + retention notes.

Marta R: Thanks all — sounds like we've got alignment on the big pieces. Followups: ensure billing team signs off on "simulated" label behavior and that dedicated customers can opt-out.
